verdict.rationale: Replit offers some non-interactive automation paths. A Replit MCP Server lets an external client create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps (replit-docs-42). Scheduled routines run recurring jobs and report back (replit-docs-49). Agent background tasks run independently in isolated copies of the project (replit-docs-39, replit-docs-48). However, nothing shows a headless CLI or CI pipeline integration, and the OpenAPI probe found no public API spec (replit-probe-2), so automation is limited to in-platform scheduling and MCP-client control. Missing for 10: a documented headless CLI/SDK, CI/CD pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions), a public REST API with a spec, token-based non-interactive auth, and hands-on corroboration.
